description: Olga is SLB software for dynamic multiphase-flow simulation. The provider identifies it as a simulator of changing fluid-flow conditions and presents a current product release. Its scope is relevant to the time-dependent operation of oil and gas production infrastructure. The provider is SLB. Coverage: Coverage follows the network or reservoir supplied by the user. Spatial detail and the simulated time horizon are model settings; there is no fixed observation period. Access: The provider page describes the software and supplies a contact route for access. No executable or example model was obtained. Licence and cost: This is commercial software. The page does not establish the applicable licence agreement or a complete price; access terms must be confirmed with the provider. Limitations: The inspected page establishes product identity and dynamic multiphase scope, but the extracted technical detail is limited. Required input formats and interface details are left unspecified. For infrastructure simulation it supports comparison of operating conditions, network capacity and proposed equipment changes. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes covers pipe-network calculations. This is a thematic relation, not a claim of software interoperability.
